neet_phy_u12_t01_1.working: At constant volume R ∝ L². Tripling the length gives R' = 9 × 5 = 45 Ω.

neet_phy_u12_t01_2.working: Halving the diameter makes A' = A/4. At constant volume R ∝ 1/A², so R' = 16 × 4 = 64 Ω.

neet_phy_u12_t01_4.working: A: double length gives 4R (IV). B: half radius makes area 1/4, giving 16R (III). C: each of 4 parts is R/4 (II). D: area 1/3 gives 9R (I).

neet_phy_u12_t01_5.working: A is false because resistivity is a material property and does not change on stretching. B, C and D are true. E is false because the SI unit of conductance is the siemens, not ohm-metre.
